## Actions

- Managed teams of 8–10 engineers in Atlassian’s Growth organization, leading delivery and cross-functional work across engineering, product, analytics, and design.
- Led delivery of major Growth programs across redesigning a project navigation and discovery surface, changing how product functionality is packaged and provisioned, embedding cross-product experiences in Jira Software, automating user provisioning, and transferring ownership of a major product surface to another organization.
- Established experiment-operations practices and operational-readiness exercises for Growth teams running cross-product experimentation.
- Drove the Unified Cross-flow Analytics standard library from spike to production deployment on cross-flow surfaces.
- Owned the Growth Eng Goal for developer productivity focused on a low/no-code approach to delivering experiments, and completed Back-to-50 velocity audits highlighting Explore-phase execution problems.

## Scope

Multipliers Growth EM delivery and experimentation operations across FY21–FY23, including platform-dependent Auto-provisioning and cross-flow analytics standardization.

## Outcomes

Shipped twelve projects in FY22 including three large complex deliveries; manager review cited Trust Score Card at 100% and projects on target once they reached Make.

## Metrics

- engineers directly managed: 8–10
- FY22 projects shipped: 12
- FY22 large complex projects called out: 3
- manager Trust Score Card (delivery reliability): 100%
